set.body: Prerequisite for Root eco-u5-core. Surface Point3D currently aliases neuroim SpatialPoint, preventing independent surface ingestion. Add one spatial4s finite XYZ interchange record, structural/raw-bit preservation and explicit construction of owned points. No implicit world/frame/unit or alignment inference; mesh PointField remains storage owner. Preserve current raw arithmetic behavior when moved, constructor invariants, and compile-time frame separation. Acceptance: core and laws JVM/JS, finite/shape/arithmetic/owner conversion witnesses, independent review; consumers migrate with one source pin across provider graph.
set.title: Own finite raw XYZ interchange values without frame assumptions
